digest.component_or_area: DC harness / Jira DC field readiness gate
propositions: Epic Link and Epic Name are provisioned by GreenHopper only when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup
The session-start readiness gate in wait_for_jira_dc_ready waited for Epic fields before any project existed, creating an ordering deadlock where the gate blocked the action that could satisfy it
Experiment 30981084637 proved the deadlock by showing fields remained absent after 180s of idle wait time but appeared within 0.05s after project creation
The harness failed all 62 cells at fixture setup (run 30975323866) with byte-identical field inventories at both 600s and 1800s budgets, ruling out a timing shortfall
The fix relocated the Epic field check from session start to _assert_project_capabilities which runs immediately after project provisioning, the only place the fields can exist
The probe script had the same ordering bug with _await_named_fields executing before project creation, requiring symmetrical reordering
